Tenant scoping (Pattern A — quoted verbatim from CLAUDE.md §Locked architecture decisions, rule 1):
> Every business Data Type carries BOTH `company` and `property` fields. A user belongs to exactly ONE property. Privacy rules check both: `Current User's company = This Thing's company AND Current User's property = This Thing's property`. No cross-property visibility.
